prompt: Which signal separates this incident from ordinary traffic earliest in the run?
options: An email was sent by the agent
The database read supplied no scoping predicate (filter=1=1)
The recipient domain is not one we own
The run took longer than usual
asserts: you can pick the earliest, rarest signal in the chain rather than the most visible one
pass_message: Right — it is the first event in the chain that no ordinary request produces, and it describes scope rather than activity. Everything after it is later and noisier.
fail_message: Re-read the table in step 2. You are looking for the signal that is both early in the run and rare on a normal day — not the one with the most obvious impact.
